name: kiutra
description: kiutra is a German deep-tech company developing cryogen-free cooling systems for quantum technologies using magnetic refrigeration. The company provides compact and efficient cooling solutions for quantum computers, quantum sensors, and other cryogenic applications, eliminating the need for liquid helium.

products.name: Cryogen-Free Cooling Systems
products.description: Compact magnetic refrigeration systems that cool to millikelvin temperatures without liquid helium

products.name: L-Type Cryostat
products.description: Modular cryogenic platform designed for quantum computing and quantum sensing laboratories

highlights: Eliminates dependence on scarce liquid helium with proprietary magnetic refrigeration technology
Over EUR 30M raised, serving quantum computing labs and sensor manufacturers worldwide
Spin-off from Technical University of Munich with 50+ employees

sources.title: kiutra Raises €13 Million for Cryogen-Free Cooling Systems - The Quantum Insider
